_move_justification.workflow: ARITHMETIC-DRIVEN, FLAG AT REVIEW. Three unrelated rows share this generic type: Triangulated Runtime Audit Protocol (6612b, a manual /runtime-audit doc unrelated to PLAN gating, 72% of the type) plus two branch-creation notes. Branch creation is AUTOMATED at LEAD-TO-PLAN per its own text, and the type still renders into CLAUDE_EXEC.md, so nothing leaves the protocol. Excluding it leaves the budget 274 tok SHORT, which is why it is here — that is a weaker reason than the others and should get a second look.
_move_justification.handoff_quality_gates: Documented reference-only by a PRIOR, independent judgment: the digest mapping already excludes it as "8.6K, gates run in code not from agent reading MD — reference only". The gates execute in code; reading them is informational.
_move_justification.plan_refactor_brief_guide: Refactor-SD-specific how-to, consulted only for refactor work.

_excluded_deliberately.signaling_friction_pointer_phase: SHARED — renders into LEAD, PLAN and EXEC and IS the /signal pointer. Moving it would strip the friction channel from every phase file.
_excluded_deliberately.PHASE_2_PLANNING: Not needed for the budget (16,482 moved vs 13,166 required) and its name signals core PLAN identity. Kept in the gated file by choice, not by accident.
_excluded_deliberately.bmad_enhancements: PULLED BACK AT EXEC. AC-7 caught it: this section carries three BINDING rules — "Never Bypass", "Never create PRDs as markdown files", "Never skip validation gates". My structural classifier missed them because it matched uppercase NEVER and these are title-case with a warning emoji. Third case-sensitivity miss on this SD; the verification, not the classifier, is what caught it.
_excluded_deliberately.design_database_validation_gates: PULLED BACK AT EXEC. Contributes "4 mandatory gates ensuring sub-agent execution and implementation fidelity". That line describes rather than instructs, so it was arguably fine to move — but the budget has margin, and spending 787 tokens to avoid a judgment call about whether MANDATORY-in-prose counts is the cheaper trade.
